checks.name: A single click of the always-available skill casts freely without selecting a target or mode
Dragging the skill shows a free aim point; releasing outside the button casts once and never rotates the camera
Esc cancels an active drag without firing or leaving a captured pointer
Optional target lock still works with the same skill key and real impact feedback
Pause disables both the skill button and keyboard casting
Phone users can tap an 82-pixel skill key to spray freely, with no target or keyboard
Native touch dragging captures the finger outside the key, previews aim and casts only on release
A native touch cancellation restores controls and never fires a ghost shot
On phones, optional lock-and-tap hits a target, and the next ground tap immediately resumes walking
Enter and Space each cast exactly once when the skill key has keyboard focus
Scene changes clear a held skill safely, with no console errors or warnings
